symptom: A page/snippet widget expression naming a member the entity lacks — `Visible: $currentObject/NoSuchAttr != empty`, also in Editable, DynamicClasses and on a page parameter `$Product/…` — passed check and exec; mx check CE0117. A bare association step (`$currentObject/Assoc/Attr`) passed too.
cause: Microflow expressions had a member check (flowMemberRefs.expressionPath, #1697); widget expressions are stored as text and nothing parsed them back. Separately, the attribute-scope walk judged widgets inside a list view's specialization template against the list view's generalized source, giving 7 false 'no attribute' errors on TestApp's Studio Pro-authored Pages.Vehicle templates (pre-existing, contentparams check).
fix: visitor.ParseExpressionText reads a widget expression back into the AST; checkExprSystemMembers (attribute-scope walk) resolves the first step of each $currentObject/ and $pageParam/ path with flowMemberRefs.member: missing attribute -> CE0117 error with near members, bare association -> CE0117 error. Qualified steps stay MDL-WIDGET13's; unresolved contexts are silent. The walk now gives a template's widgets its Specialization as context.
insight: Measured on 11.12.6 with one widget per case: a widget expression cannot follow ANY association (bare, qualified, missing are each CE0117), so only the first member step needs resolving. Before trusting a new member check, run every describe of a Studio Pro-authored project back through check: that sweep (157 TestApp pages and snippets) found the template-context bug the unit tests could not.
test: mdl/executor/validate_widget_expr_members_2258_test.go TestWidgetExpressionMembers (controls: real members, a qualified association, a static Visible) and TestWidgetExpressionMembers_TemplateUsesItsSpecialization
